about_the_game:
Overview:

Ever since the Nature's Legacy Institute opened its doors, furry thieves have been raiding the trash cans. The museum has become their personal buffet, and they're not leaving until they get every last bite.

Play as Raccoons With a Plan:

Step into the paws of a crafty raccoon on a mission to grab those leftover ingredients from the museum trash. Go solo and stick to the shadows, or team up with your crew to pose as humans and walk right through the front door. Your goal stays the same: find the hamburger using your wits and cutting-edge raccoon tech, then get out before anyone catches on. The museum staff never stop watching—one wrong move and you're busted.

Play as the Museum Staff With a Problem:

You work at this prestigious Institute, and now, all of a sudden, you have to deal with these trash-raiding pests while just trying to get through your work day. Use every tool and trick at your disposal to spot the raccoons before they destroy the place on your shift. Team up with other staff to outsmart these furry criminals and keep the museum from turning into a raccoon playground.

The ultimate showdown between raccoons and humans unfolds in the halls of the Nature's Legacy Institute. Will you be able to outsmart the enemy, or outlast the chaos that is Trash Can Tactics.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ 7 240H
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 1060 Laptop
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Needs a dedicated GPU

short_description: Someone's been raiding the Nature's Legacy Institute. Not the priceless artifacts. Not the research specimens. The food. Pick your side in this ridiculous turf war: play as raccoons with a plan, or museum staff with a problem, in this asymmetrical PvP heist.
